FRLMLegalAuthenticationis equivalent toLegalAuthenticator
FRLMLegalAuthentication.dateTimeis equivalent toLegalAuthenticator.time (Date et heure de la prise de responsabilité)
FRLMLegalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x]is equivalent toLegalAuthenticator.assignedEntity (Responsable du document)Cas où legalAuthenticator[x] référence un FRLMHealthProfessional, cf. FRHealthProfessionalLMCDAFHIR.

Code sourcerelationCode cibleCommentaire
FRLMLegalAuthenticationis equivalent toComposition.attester (Attests to accuracy of composition)attester.where(mode='legal')
FRLMLegalAuthentication.dateTimeis equivalent toComposition.attester.time (When the composition was attested)
FRLMLegalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x]is equivalent toComposition.attester.party (Who attested the composition)Cas où legalAuthenticator[x] référence un FRLMHealthProfessional (attester.party.resolve().ofType(PractitionerRole)) — cf. FRHealthProfessionalLMCDAFHIR.
FRLMLegalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x]is equivalent toComposition.attester.party (Who attested the composition)Cas où legalAuthenticator[x] référence un FRLMPatient (attester.party.resolve().ofType(Patient)) — cf. FRPatientLMCDAFHIR.
FRLMLegalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x]is equivalent toComposition.attester.party (Who attested the composition)Cas où legalAuthenticator[x] référence un FRLMDevice (attester.party.resolve().ofType(Device)) — cf. FRDeviceLMCDAFHIR (composant commun).
FRLMLegalAuthentication.legalAuthenticator[x]is equivalent toComposition.attester.party (Who attested the composition)Cas où legalAuthenticator[x] référence un FRLMOrganisation (attester.party.resolve().ofType(Organization)) — cf. FROrganisationLMCDAFHIR.
